3.  24-55251  Recommendation to receive and file a report on CoC builds Notice of Funding
  Opportunity and to approve the CoC in pursuing potential projects.

  • City Staff Jeffrey Proctor presented on the CoC Builds NOFO.
  • HUD released the (CoCBuilds) Notice of Funding Opportunity on July 22,
  2024, $175 million in funding available nationally for an estimated 25
  projects, Applications are due November 21, 2024.
  • This is a one-time funding for new construction, acquisition, or rehabilitation
  of PSH specifically for capitol costs and activities associated with PSH.
  • Majority of funding request must be for capitol costs, there is a 15-year use
  requirement.
  • HUD priorities, rating factors, environmental justice preference points and
  timeline standards were discussed.
  • The City of Long Beach requests CoC approval to release the RFP to solicit
  project proposals.
  • City staff Jeffrey Proctor discussed the eligible applicant’s conditions, project
  overview, priorities and RFP timeline.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Martins, seconded by Member Richert, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Tan, Diles III, Brezenoff, Richert, Martins, Amick, Shuford
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  McCullom, Wee, Lock
